title: Machine learning derived ORC6 as a hub biomarker for predicting tumor microenvironment, prognoses, and therapeutic responses in lung adenocarcinoma.
authors: Huang, Xin; Feng, Dongfeng; Tian, Yanhua; Zhang, Xu; Li, Yishuai; He, Yeju; Liu, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习筛选ORC6作为肺腺癌预后与免疫微环境生物标志物，虽涉及DNA结合复合物但无TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，属纯生物信息学与湿实验验证，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The origin recognition complex (ORC) is a DNA-binding complex composed of six subunits involved in DNA replication in cancer cells. The prognostic and immunological implications of ORC6 in lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) are not yet clear. This study utilizes multiple databases (such as TCGA, GEO, GTEx, etc.) to investigate the potential significance of ORC6 in LUAD. The results show that high ORC6 expression is associated with advanced disease and poorer prognosis and is involved in biological processes such as cell cycle regulation, DNA replication, and signal transduction. The expression of ORC6 correlates negatively with the infiltration of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells but positively with the infiltration of cancer-associated fibroblasts and endothelial cells. Additionally, a positive correlation between ORC6 and immunosuppression-related genes (such as LAG3 and PDCD1) was found. Validation of ORC6 expression was conducted through qRT-PCR, western blotting, and immunofluorescence, indicating its potential diagnostic, prognostic, and therapeutic value in LUAD.
abstract_zh: 起源识别复合体（origin recognition complex, ORC）是一种由六个亚基组成的DNA结合复合体，参与癌细胞中的DNA复制。ORC6在肺腺癌（lung adenocarcinoma, LUAD）中的预后及免疫学意义尚不明确。本研究利用多个数据库（如TCGA、GEO、GTEx等）探讨ORC6在LUAD中的潜在意义。结果显示，ORC6高表达与疾病晚期及较差预后相关，并参与细胞周期调控、DNA复制及信号转导等生物过程。ORC6的表达与CD4+和CD8+ T细胞的浸润呈负相关，但与癌症相关成纤维细胞和内皮细胞的浸润呈正相关。此外，研究发现ORC6与免疫抑制相关基因（如LAG3和PDCD1）之间存在正相关。通过qRT-PCR、western blotting和免疫荧光对ORC6表达进行了验证，表明其在LUAD中具有潜在的诊断、预后及治疗价值。
